'''Zapantler''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Sparkdoe]] at 18 stars, and into [[Magnedart]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Rose through the ranks at the cost of sleep-deprivation. Instead of magnetically summoning thunder, Zapantler longs to summon a vacation instead."

Zapantler is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A brown and yellow deer. Each of its antlers are two conjoined U-shaped magnets.

Zapantler's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces yellow with cyan.

== Evolution Trial ==
Zapantler's evolution trials unlock once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Magnedart]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Play [[Fishing Contest]] (use Fishing Rods x6000) or [[Marathon Party]] (use boards x6000).
* Feed Zapantler 15 Tempura Plates.

== Trivia ==
* Old Bio: "To become the leader of the herd and have all the candy, who cares how many [[Zobos]] it has to fight?
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "As long as there's candy, who cares how many Zobos there are? Besides, everything's better once you're the manager!"
